findings.reason: Ingress rule permits TCP port 22 from CIDR 0.0.0.0/0, allowing unrestricted SSH access.
findings.evidence: dynamic "ingress" { for_each = local.ingress_cidrs content { from_port = 22 to_port = 22 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = [ingress.value] } } with local.ingress_cidrs = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
